entry.title: Resolution 666 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): FC-176: Recommended adoption - 9/1/2026
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE UNITED STATES, DEPARTMENT OF LABOR, EMPLOYMENT AND TRAINING ADMINISTRATION, TO RECEIVE A GRANT OF WORKFORCE INNOVATION AND OPPORTUNITY ACT PROGRAM FUNDS

Allows for the receipt of $1,300,000 in federally-derived funds to be used to provide services that enhance employment opportunities, job retention, earnings, skill development and literacy.

Latest action: FC-176: Recommended adoption - 9/1/2026
